scoped_review.conclusion: This tree contains instructions and templates, not a hosted runtime. The launch skill calls for owner credentials in local environment/vault storage rather than chat, exposes permission/network decisions and stages write connectors behind explicit configuration. Outbox mocks are not delivered messages; custom-tool mocks block pending a host response and are unsuitable for unattended scheduling. Live launch, spend, network policy and schedule mutations require operator authority in the executing environment. No credentials were supplied, no provider call was made and no deployment or inspected script was run during this census.

entities.name: Loop knowledge-base architecture
entities.description: Durable workstream organization reference separating recurring domain charters and timelines from reusable documents, incoming signals and the shared activity log.
dependencies: A filesystem or versioned knowledge base

triggers: arbitrary project execution and repository mutations
scoped_review.conclusion: The workflow intentionally delegates command execution and writes to its host agents. It copies ignored environment files into a new worktree and may install dependencies, so worktree isolation does not isolate secrets or make untrusted projects safe to run. Setup and later phases interpolate repository/task strings into agent instructions, not a hardened execution sandbox. The launcher can terminate its session and optional infrastructure; customize and review all commands before running. Host permissions, actual verification results and safe target selection remain integration responsibilities. No source execution, dependency installation, PR creation or license permission was assumed during cataloguing; missing licensing is recorded with reference-only recommendations.
